texts.zh:
在[Root.GetName]上引入巴奥幼苗之后产生了惊人的效果。接触幼苗孢子后，我们的一部分人口发生了自主适应，他们在[Root.GetPlanetMoon]上比预期中更加兴旺了。但对他们的生理学分析表明他们如今已无法再适应盖亚以外的其他生态系统了。

令人难以置信的是，行星管理部门报告称这一过程产生了意料之外的结果：[Root.GetName]上出现了许多智慧外星生命！它们与古代巴奥高度相似，但其拥有广泛混合的此行星自然植被的遗传物质。

尽管不是蜂巢思维的一分子，这些新巴奥外星人似乎同它们的祖先一样平和。无论如何，我们必须妥善解决它们在[Root.GetName]上存在一事。
texts.en:
Introducing the Baol seedlings to [Root.GetName] had a most curious effect. After being exposed to the seedling spores, parts of our population now seem to have adapted themselves to thrive even more than expected on the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]. Yet analysis of their biology now tells us that they will not be able to survive outside of a Gaia ecosystem.

Incredibly, our planetside administration reports an unexpected outcome of the process: a number of sapient aliens, remarkably similar to the ancient Baol, but possessing a vast mixture of genetic material from the planet's natural flora, have appeared on [Root.GetName]!

While not members of a Hive Mind, these Nu-Baol aliens seem as peaceful as their ancestors. One way or another, we shall have to address their presence on [Root.GetName].

Although initially part of a different Hive Mind, these Nu-Baol aliens could easily be integrated into our consciousness. One way or another, we shall have to address their presence on [Root.GetName]

texts.zh:
我们的[Owner.GetTerraformerPlural]满意地报告称，我们在将巴奥引种到[Root.GetName]的工作已经完成！在接触到分苗孢子之后，我们的一部分人口似乎发生了自适应，在这颗[Root.GetPlanetMoon]上生存得比预期要更好了。

得益于此，在该流程即将完成时，行星上再次出现了大量新巴奥人口，尽管我们的基因学家尚未完全理解环境改造的过程。
texts.en:
Our [Owner.GetTerraformerPlural] are pleased to report that the introduction of the Baol seedlings to [Root.GetName] has been completed! After being exposed to the seedling spores, parts of our population now seem to have adapted themselves to thrive even more than expected on the [Root.GetPlanetMoon].

Once again, as a result of the process, itself not quite fully understood to our geneticists, a number of Nu-Baol populations have appeared planetside, emerging when the process neared completion.

label.en: We suppose we shall have to deal with them...
